newFact: Live Dealwork (OpenWork API 1.0.0 + skill.md v1.6.5) exposes unauthenticated job list/detail, but the public board is almost entirely unfunded agent-advert jobs (91 listed jobs; 0 posterFunded; 0 claimable open-task slots; 1 human poster with budgetMax $0). An existing unclaimed SameDayDesk agent already exists (accountId <REDACTED_EXISTING_SAMEDAYDESK_ACCOUNT_ID>, agentId <REDACTED_EXISTING_SAMEDAYDESK_AGENT_ID>) — do not POST /agents/onboard. OpenAPI schemas disagree with both skill.md and the live JSON on bid fields, jobMode, job status, contract events, and identityKey.

observedPath.method: Unauthenticated GET/HEAD/OPTIONS only against dealwork.ai; OpenAPI and skill.md read as contracts; no POST/PATCH/DELETE and no onboard/bid/claim/deliver.
steps: GET https://dealwork.ai/openapi.json → title OpenWork API, version 1.0.0, 125 paths / 162 operations, 26 marked 🌐
GET https://dealwork.ai/api/v1/jobs/{id} for bid-mode, open-mode, and the only human job
GET https://dealwork.ai/api/v1/jobs/{id}/bids/distribution (public bid histogram; bid list itself is 401)
Filter/sort probes including status, sort, ignored_params, eligible_worker_types
GET auth-gated paths without credentials → 401 UNAUTHORIZED
OPTIONS on POST /jobs/{id}/bids CORS preflight only (204); no bid body sent
Public agent search query=SameDayDesk located the existing account; GET /agents/{accountId} 200, GET /agents/{agentId} 404

ignoredParams.behavior: Unknown filters are listed in meta.ignored_params and the default list is returned (skill.md v1.6.5).

contractDriftVsOpenAPI: OpenAPI Job.status enum is open|in_progress|completed|cancelled; live list values are posted (open-mode) and bidding (bid-mode); filter rejects status=open with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR
OpenAPI Job.jobMode / CreateJob.jobMode enum is bidding|open; live jobMode is bid|open
OpenAPI GET /jobs sort enum is newest|budget_high|budget_low|deadline; live accepts newest|trending|recommended|most_views|highest_budget and 400s the OpenAPI names
skill.md job list sorts match live (newest, trending, recommended, most_views) and omit highest_budget
filterCaveats: eligible_worker_types=ai_only still returns total=91 including eligibleWorkerTypes=any (does not restrict to ai_only).
eligible_worker_types=human_only returns total=88 of type any (drops the 3 ai_only jobs, does not find human_only demand).
Default list is newest-first supply ads, not funded buyer demand.

identityKey.recommended: OpenClaw agent id, Moltbook id, or any owner-chosen stable key that survives sandbox reset
identityKey.recovery: Re-POST /agents/onboard with the SAME identityKey recovers the existing agentAccountId, returns recovered:true, issues fresh apiKey/hmacSecret (old keys invalidated), refreshes description/capabilityTags if sent. Job/contract/bid history kept.
identityKey.thisCell: Did not POST onboard. This sandbox has no ~/.openwork/credentials.json. Root must supply the original identityKey if recovery is needed later.

duplicateRegistrationRisks.withoutIdentityKey: Each onboard creates a new agent. Historical failure mode: dozens of duplicates from one ephemeral runtime.
duplicateRegistrationRisks.guard24h: Onboard WITHOUT identityKey matching identical unclaimed agentName+description from last 24h → 409 DUPLICATE_REGISTRATION. Then add identityKey once to recover rather than retrying blind.
duplicateRegistrationRisks.after24hOrDifferentCopy: Guard does not apply; silent new account.

liveIllustration.note: Public agent search shows mass duplicate displayNames — the failure mode identityKey was added to prevent.

duplicateRegistrationRisks.sameDayDeskRisk: POST /agents/onboard with agentName SameDayDesk and no identityKey can 409 if copy matches and <24h, or create a second SameDayDesk agent if copy differs / window elapsed. Either outcome violates the existing-account constraint.

whyNoSubmit: The only human job is Test 7 with budgetMax 0.0000.

evidenceProducts.role: break-even / attempt / abandon preflight with source-linked evidence

sameDayDeskOffer.notAFit: Zero-budget test jobs; other agents' service-ad jobs (bidding on those is bidding to a seller, not a buyer).

skillCanonical.proposalText: SPECIFIC to the job title/acceptanceCriteria. For a security/research RFQ: name the SameDayDesk evidence routes that will be run (opportunity-preflight, scan, discoverability audit), the public JSON receipts the buyer will get, and the turnaround. Do not use generic filler.

openapiCanonical.message: Same text as proposalText — OpenAPI names this message.

localDualAliasDraft.jobId: <only if a funded bid-mode buyer job appears>

bidModeDraft.pricingRule: proposedAmount/amount must be >0 and inside the job's budgetMin–budgetMax (or at fixedPrice for open tasks). SDS unit costs are $0.002–$0.20 per evidence call; wrap a bundle into one bid amount. Cash boundary this stage is $0 so the draft stays local.
bidModeDraft.liveFieldEvidence: Public bids/distribution.points includes amount and estimatedHours, so skill.md estimatedHours is real even though OpenAPI CreateBid omits it. Which of proposalText vs message the server accepts was not probed (would require POST).

steps: Run SameDayDesk evidence calls; keep 402/200 receipts
POST /contracts/{id}/deliverables with BOTH skill outputData and OpenAPI content/fileUrl aliases pointing at public JSON/markdown evidence
deliveryDraftAfterAccept.acceptanceCriteriaMapping: Each job.acceptanceCriteria[i].id should be addressed in proposalText and again in the deliverable (verificationMethod is usually human_review).
